description: This file defines the 'FileLoader' class, a Java class responsible for loading resources from the file system by extending 'ResourceLoader'. It provides methods to retrieve URLs and InputStreams for specified file locations, throwing custom exceptions if resources are not found or cannot be opened.

classes.name: FileLoader
classes.description: A class that loads resources from the file system by extending 'ResourceLoader' and implementing 'Serializable'. It provides methods to obtain resource URLs and input streams, handling exceptions related to file access.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Retrieves the URL for a resource at the specified location, throwing 'GenericConfigException' if the resource is not found.

methods.name: loadResource
methods.description: Loads the resource at the specified location as an InputStream, throwing 'GenericConfigException' if an I/O error occurs.
